content.title: Chapter 2 - ADMINISTRATION — Sec. 2-231. - Fiscal year.
content.summary:
Pursuant to Charter, section 10.1, the date of the beginning of the fiscal year of
               the city is hereby designated as January 1 of each year. The financial business of
               the city shall be conducted and carried on in accordance with such date.
